data.final_table_comment: Final feature table built by final_features from 2 feature-selection run(s) sharing target='upopen_5pct_5day' and setup [lookback_d=1, horizon_h=6, normalize=none, feature_normalize=cs_rank, corr_threshold=0.9, n_splits=5, min_train=500, random_state=18, selector_class=CrossSectionalSelector, methods=permutation, spearman, xgb_shap, design_dtype=float64, env_fingerprint=cf51e65b3a15]. Shortlist fingerprint: 7f5408240792 over 157 channels. 157 channels from 2 pool(s). Selection layer 1: ⚠️ a UNION of per-pool runs, NOT a consensus - a channel offered to one run could never be a candidate in another, so agreement was not available to measure (.claude/context/final_features.md section 6). Run evidence: cleared_p95_not_a_pass=2. ⚠️ UNIVERSE: restricted to the 228 names the selection ranked across, and the label is a rank WITHIN them — AAA, ABB, ACB, ACV, ANV, APH, ASM, BAF, … (sha1 335362d964). ⚠️ CHANNELS=ALL: every numeric channel of each pool whose selection run is in the plan - the selection decided WHICH POOLS, not the width inside one. Source runs: 2026-09-18_115344__liquid__event_features__upopen_5pct_5day; 2026-09-18_121820__liquid__basic__upopen_5pct_5day

features.selection: done upstream by feature_selection, selection layer 1: this table is the UNION of its runs' shortlists (.claude/context/final_features.md §6), which is arithmetic and not consensus — a channel one run never saw could not be chosen twice. Nothing is selected here.

imputation.not_used: ffill/bfill — bfill fills a leading gap with a future value

drift.note: share of TEST rows more than 5 train-sigmas from the train mean. A channel at 1.0 was never inside the range the model was fitted on.

basket.best_rule: max val_daily_auc (the other val metrics break a tie), excluding BASELINE_PRIOR
basket.entry_screen: none: a name at its ceiling on N is bought
basket.min_prob_rule: max val ev over 51 cuts, >= 25 active val sessions

report_config.best_rule: max VAL ROC-AUC, excluding BASELINE_PRIOR and BLEND (a FIXED ensemble is eligible)
report_config.refit_rule: the run's own config refitted on train+val, test scored once
report_config.rolling_rule: refitted every 21 test sessions on all rows ending d+h-1 samples before the block; blocks pooled
report_config.threshold_rule: VAL threshold maximising F1, applied once to TEST
